bio: You would probably walk right past this cosy ristorante, were it not for the vibrant energy emanating from it. The atmospheric decor, the bustle of the open kitchen at the back and the congenial service team immediately put you in the right mood. The chef demonstrates a deft hand with traditional fare, from house-made pasta with a bold lamb ragù to a fresh take on tiramisu bursting with those familiar rich flavours. A few surprises, like Dutch cheese or katsuobushi, give things a modern and international twist. Chef Roberto Borelli definitely puts his own stamp on Italian cooking....
